design.anchor_scope: cKG-1024 is a custom prefix-preserving post hoc numerical anchor, not a package default or the conventional nmc=1024 draw order.
design.bank_construction: Draw production Zf[0:512], then production Zg[0:512], then fresh Zf[512:1024], then fresh Zg[512:1024]; compare channel-wise prefixes.
design.fantasy_seed_note: The cKG fantasy bank is fixed at seed 0 for every trial; trial seeds vary data and paths, not the fantasy-bank realization.
design.interpretation: agreement is a nested-count stability sensitivity, not accuracy or convergence
design.reference_compatibility: The 512 channel prefixes and 512 reference paths remain production-compatible.

blas.name: openblas64
blas.openblas configuration: USE_64BITINT=1 DYNAMIC_ARCH=1 DYNAMIC_OLDER= NO_CBLAS= NO_LAPACK= NO_LAPACKE= NO_AFFINITY=1 USE_OPENMP= SANDYBRIDGE MAX_THREADS=3

production_512_compatibility_preflight.note: The nested 512 prefix and production cKG were identical on all audited fields.
